title: Normalized free horn quotient is a two-term disk
statement: Fix a commutative ring $\Lambda$, an integer $n\geq1$ and $0\leq k\leq n$. Use simplicial sets and horns as in [lem-coef-kan-quillen-right-proper], and the normalization $N$ on simplicial $\Lambda$-modules from [lem-cbc-dold-kan-normalization-equivalence]. For a simplicial set $S$, let $\Lambda[S]$ be the simplicial module freely generated in each degree by $S$ in that degree, with operators induced linearly. Put $K=N\Lambda[\Lambda_k^n]$ and $B=N\Lambda[\Delta^n]$, and let $i:K\to B$ be induced by the horn inclusion. Let $D^n$ be the nonnegative chain complex with a free rank-one module in degrees $n$ and $n-1$, zero in other degrees, and differential the identity from degree $n$ to degree $n-1$. Then $i$ is a split monomorphism of chain complexes, and there is an isomorphism $K\oplus D^n\cong B$ carrying the summand inclusion of $K$ to $i$. Under the natural nondegenerate-string model $P(n)$ of [lem-cbc-normalized-simplex-chain-diagonal], $K$ is the subcomplex spanned by every strictly increasing string except the top string $[0,\ldots,n]$ and the omitted face $[0,\ldots,\widehat k,\ldots,n]$. These two classes freely generate $B/iK$ in degrees $n$ and $n-1$, respectively, with differential $(-1)^k$ between them.
